source_rows.title: [2607.20792] Memoir: Should a Model Write to Its Memory While It Thinks?

field_principles.status: Records the terminal V565 source-model-method contract state.
field_principles.honest_verdict: States the source and cache outcome without turning preflight into experimental evidence.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum for this preflight: null or partial.
field_principles.query_receipts: Keeps each sequential low-concurrency source query dated and reproducible.
field_principles.source_rows: Records one row per checked paper, product, repository, or index route.
field_principles.primary_source_hashes: Binds primary and first-party pages to source hashes.
field_principles.citation_trail_receipts: Records dated EBT and ARM-EBM citation routes with endpoint caveats.
field_principles.citation_count_boundaries: Prevents citation indexes from becoming fabricated current counts.
field_principles.drift_bench_provenance_contract: Freezes DRIFT-Bench URL, revision, license, schema, corruption warning, and local regeneration rule.
field_principles.model_cache_resolution_rows: Records mandated GGUF cache identity without loading or running models.
field_principles.frozen_external_split_contract: Freezes external family and chronology split fields before outcomes.
field_principles.frozen_router_contract: Freezes structural controls, calibration, abstention, and exact fallback.
field_principles.frozen_embedding_contract: Freezes paired-embedding conditions and shortcut attacks.
field_principles.frozen_transactional_learning_contract: Freezes memory isolation, commit boundary, support, retention, restart, and rollback fields.
field_principles.frozen_arc_parser_contract: Freezes the qwen3_xml live-path parser and stop-rule boundary.
field_principles.hardware_stop_contract: Freezes GateMate, TSU, and product-only hardware boundaries.
field_principles.non_transfer_rows: Names claims that do not transfer into Carnot.
field_principles.v565_method_contract_ready_score: Gate score opens only when adopted methods, cache, spelling, and protected-file gates pass.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Names failed source, cache, schema, protection, and readiness gates with observed values.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Flattens source, cache, contract, boundary, and gate rows for recomputation.
field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Recomputes readiness from rows instead of trusting narrative text.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records network, query, tool, cache, source-path, git, and protected-hash preconditions.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares source and cache preflight with no experimental LLM inference.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because source and cache preflight is not a correctness oracle.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each required field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each required field to receipts, source rows, cache rows, or deterministic reducers.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins deterministic row ordering for this no-randomness contract.
field_principles.tests_run: Records validation commands and exit codes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Detects drift in source rows, cache rows, contracts, gates, and receipts.
